ownershipResolution.commonGap: About 1,370 common holders existed at signing; confidential PWM/client, employee, management and transferee identities/stakes are UNRESOLVED. Future closing allocations are not cutoff holdings.

ownershipResolution.financing: MN8 issued 325m Series A units at $1; signed 2023-12-22, closed 2024-03-28: Mercuria 200m, WSI 125m. Senior; 10% cumulative cash/PIK; participate/vote as converted; holder/majority conversion; protective consents; holder redemption after year 7, company call after year 2. The class has one director/observer. WSI's separate observer is nonvoting/noncontrolling and needs 25% retention. No company control proved.

operatingResolution.profile: U.S. solar/storage owner-operator: about 870 projects in 29 states, 3.9 GW solar and 440 MW battery operating/under construction at 2026-03-31; 200+ enterprise customers.
operatingResolution.boundaryRule: Count once; exclude project equity, tax equity, debt and counterparties absent company-equity proof.

The 2026-08-12 10-Q still said proposed; no close, amendment or termination found by cutoff.
